# Hero Laboratory

> Practical, beginner-friendly guides, ebooks and ChatGPT prompt packs for making money online with free AI tools: side hustles, freelancing, Threads growth, small business marketing, Etsy, real estate, teaching and job search. Honest numbers, no income guarantees.

## Guides
- [How to Use ChatGPT to Study for Exams (Without Cheating)](https://herolaboratory.github.io/guides/how-to-use-chatgpt-to-study-for-exams-without-cheating/): To study for exams with ChatGPT without cheating, use it as a tutor rather than a ghostwriter: turn your syllabus into a study plan, have hard concepts explained at your level, explain them back from memory, and get quizzed one question at a time. Check your syllabus's AI rules first and verify facts against your course materials.
- [How to Use ChatGPT for Restaurant Marketing (in 30 Minutes a Week)](https://herolaboratory.github.io/guides/how-to-use-chatgpt-for-restaurant-marketing/): Use ChatGPT for restaurant marketing by giving it a one-time fact sheet about your restaurant, then batching a week of social posts, turning each special into a post, sign and text, drafting calm review replies and writing catering or event pages – about 30 minutes a week. Always check facts, prices and allergens yourself.
- [How to Make Your First $100 Online (With No Startup Money)](https://herolaboratory.github.io/guides/how-to-make-your-first-100-dollars-online/): To make your first $100 online with no money, pick one path for 30 days (a simple service, a small digital product or affiliate posts), make one sample in two hours, set an easy-yes price of $25–$50 for a service or $3–$10 for a product, and send 20–50 offers where your buyers already are.
